summary: A multi-engine synth firmware based on Felucca that drops the samples in favour of extra synth and drum engines, more sequences per track and expanded chord modes.
features: Eight swappable sequences per track, chainable up to 512 steps
Per-step preset changes within the same engine
Generative "GEN" arp mode with density, chord, evolve and algorithm controls
Strum and chord-shaping modes using the black keys
Adds SWARM, FM-TONE, WAVETONE, DRUM-X and its own SH-TONE engine
No samples or granular engine; tested on one unit

headings: the differences between this and felucca
five new synth engines; one unique to this firmware, four from other firmwares
user slicer settings on the slicer 2 page
